boundaries: Single physical connection; no Redis AUTH/HELLO/SELECT handshake or request/reply scheduler.
Redis/Valkey PING and ECHO are transport smoke evidence, not command/engine/provider certification.
Native readable backpressure and logical write bounds are not an RSS or performance certification.
